page_title: ROM 3-0 CRE | AS Roma v Cremonese 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: El Shaarawy S. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Marco Di Bello has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
89' Mikayil Faye (Cremonese) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.

89' Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) evades challenges and shoots from the edge of the box. It's a good effort, but flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
86' 3 - 0 Goal! Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 3:0.
85' Zeki Celik will be replaced by Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma).

81' Wasted effort! Manu Kone (AS Roma) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
81' Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

80' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went a whisker over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
79' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Cremonese is cautioned for aggressive play. AS Roma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
77' 2 - 0 Goal! Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) takes a short pass from Bryan Cristante in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
77' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
74' The corner from Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) is hurriedly cleared.
74' The substitution is prepared. Mikayil Faye (Cremonese) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alessio Zerbin.
74' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Milan Djuric (Cremonese) replacing Giuseppe Pezzella.

73' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lorenzo Pellegrini departs the field of play to be replaced by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma).
70' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
69' Manu Kone (AS Roma) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Cremonese have been awarded a free kick.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cremonese.
66' Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma) sees a yellow card from Marco Di Bello after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
65' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
64' A pass into the box finds Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Emil Audero denies him.
63' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
63' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Antonio Sanabria is replaced by Jamie Vardy (Cremonese).
63' Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.

59' 1 - 0 Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Lorenzo Pellegrini. His header was precise and ended up inside the right post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:0.
59' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is about to take a corner kick.
58' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
57' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
56' Cremonese are ruled offside.
56' That's the end of the game for Bryan Zaragoza, who is replaced by Lorenzo Venturino (AS Roma).
54' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
53' Half-chance! Donyell Malen (AS Roma) plays a pass into the box, but Emil Audero reacts well to snuff out the attack. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner.
51' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
51' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
50' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
49' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Martin Payero limps off the pitch to be replaced by Warren Bondo (Cremonese).
49' Martin Payero (Cremonese) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Daniele Ghilardi comes off for Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Flag goes up against Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
45+4' Martin Payero (Cremonese) is able to continue to play.
45+3' Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+3' The game is interrupted now, Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Martin Payero (Cremonese) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
44' Manu Kone (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Marco Di Bello blows for a foul. Cremonese win a free kick.
44' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
42' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
41' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
38' Martin Payero (Cremonese) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
37' The referee blows his whistle as Wesley Franca (AS Roma) was too aggressive in his challenge. Cremonese get a free kick.
37' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Di Bello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Cremonese have a free kick.
36' Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for an infringement. Cremonese will take a free kick.
35' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
35' What a chance that is! Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!

34' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
33' Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! AS Roma are awarded the free kick.
29' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) commits a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to AS Roma.
28' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.
26' Manu Kone (AS Roma) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
25' The corner from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is cleared away by the defence.
25' Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AS Roma.
25' A lofted cross from Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
24' A yellow card for a tackle by Morten Thorsby (Cremonese). Marco Di Bello doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
23' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Marco Di Bello signals a set piece. It's a free kick to Cremonese in a dangerous position.
22' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Cremonese have a free kick.
22' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul. Cremonese are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
21' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
21' AS Roma keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
19' Donyell Malen (AS Roma) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.

16' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Zeki Celik (AS Roma), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
16' Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
15' Sebastiano Luperto (Cremonese) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick to AS Roma.
14' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. AS Roma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
14' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Manu Kone (AS Roma) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
13' Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
12' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
12' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
12' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to AS Roma.

11' Marco Di Bello interrupts the game. One of the players from Cremonese won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to AS Roma, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
10' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
10' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
9' Bryan Zaragoza (AS Roma) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. AS Roma get a corner.
8' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent. AS Roma are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
5' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
